si_entry_wedge.entry_wedge: Launch an application-domain rationalization sprint covering one high-cost technology domain and its supplier/service dependencies.
si_entry_wedge.rationale: Citizens has explicitly disclosed stack rationalization and supplier actions under Reimagine. A single-domain sprint converts those management levers into a decision-ready disposition backlog with cost, resilience, dependency and contract impacts before any broader portfolio action.
si_entry_wedge.first_meeting_theme: Which application domain has the clearest combination of Reimagine savings potential, supplier complexity and technical debt—and what disposition decisions can be made without disrupting critical services?
first_30_day_action: Create the in-scope application and supplier baseline with run-cost, lifecycle and dependency data.
Classify applications into retain, remediate, consolidate, retire or further-analysis candidates using agreed criteria.
Produce a prioritized 90-day rationalization backlog with savings ranges, dependency risks and contract decision dates.
Define control gates for retirement, transition and service-continuity decisions.
key_risks: Incomplete application and dependency inventory can create false retirement candidates.
Supplier contract terms and renewal dates may limit timing or savings.
Shared services and hidden integrations can increase retirement and transition risk.
Savings estimates can be overstated if stranded infrastructure and support costs are omitted.
Managed-services scope cannot be assumed from supplier optimization activity.

reference_architecture_to_prepare: Application-portfolio disposition architecture showing business services, dependencies, resilience tiers, supplier boundaries and transition paths.
key_delivery_risks: Incomplete application and dependency inventory can create false retirement candidates.
Supplier contract terms and renewal dates may limit timing or savings.
Shared services and hidden integrations can increase retirement and transition risk.
Savings estimates can be overstated if stranded infrastructure and support costs are omitted.
Managed-services scope cannot be assumed from supplier optimization activity.
key_controls_or_compliance_consideration: Third-party risk where supplier scope changes
